answer: A beacon spot-check plus a compute heartbeat stops bulk fake identities. Each agent enters through one inlet checkpoint, posts a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, and must answer a violet beacon flash with fresh proof of work within 60 seconds. Running 100 fakes means 100 bonds and 100 machines across the ocean; a missed heartbeat burns that bond. One honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards, while fakes bleed faster than they earn.
